{{Quote|If there's a place that had too much life, it was. What land mass exists is dominated by these stinking swamp forests. The native population spends most of their lives beating back the jungle.|[[Roblio Darté]]|<ref name="Republic 61">[[Republic 61|''Republic'' 61]]</ref>}}
'''Parcelus Minor''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. Its small amount of landmass was almost entirely covered with [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]]; the natives of the planet spent much time simply pushing the edge of the swamp back. All plant life on Parcelus Minor exuded [[tzeotine]], a combustible resin used by the native population for heating and [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]].

==History==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was [[Battle of Parcelus Minor|bombarded]] by the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]], igniting the flammable jungle and starting a fire that spread across much of the surface, wiping out or injuring most of both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] ground forces. By the time of the New Republic, the planet had recovered.

==Behind the scenes==
The planet was misspelled "Paracelus Minor" in ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''.<ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>
